body: Implement ADR-0010 and docs/specs/sharded-ticket-store.md through the eight dependency-ordered slices tracked by epic #179. Preserve the 1.x mutable loadTickets facade and legacy read/write fallback; add the zero-dependency @adlc/tickets domain, strict directory and Git-tree readers, immutable snapshots and dual hashes, recoverable journaled writes, intent-specific TicketService APIs, dry-run-first unified CLI, explicit migration consent, tracked archive, consumer and rails integration, cross-platform verification, and documentation. Do not migrate this repository's .adlc/tickets.json in the implementation diff. Acceptance is the AC1-AC16 command matrix in the normative spec, complete repository tests, P3 rail adequacy review, and P5 prosecution with no unresolved high findings. Suppressions: none.
title: Build the sharded ticket store compatibility bridge
